beats.direction: Use the recurring witness with an on-screen disclaimer: CITY CONTEXT / NOT DAY-SPECIFIC.
beats.voice: Tokyo makes translation infrastructural across permission, venue, moving image, language, textile exchange, recognition and retained seasons. This chapter follows backstage coordination: The same field that helps a show run—a name, measurement, image, availability or location—can also make labor newly trackable and extractable.
beats.onScreen: Then: JFWO states that manufacturers, designers and distributors cooperate in the organization and that its textile division operates alongside Fashion Week.

beats.direction: Animate only line reveals and state changes in the original evidence diagram.
beats.voice: JFWO states that manufacturers, designers and distributors cooperate in the organization and that its textile division operates alongside Fashion Week. That earlier record fixes a point in time; it does not prove an inevitable progression toward the present.
beats.onScreen: Now: Tokyo Textile Scope is a distinct trade-facing surface connected to the same organizational ecosystem.
beats.credit: Graphic © Rayven-Nikkita Collins; sources in claim ledger

beats.direction: Animate only line reveals and state changes in the original evidence diagram.
beats.voice: The distinction is material. A polished interface can survive after its workers, contracts, specifications or permission trail disappear, leaving the audience with an outcome but not its operating history.
beats.onScreen: Next: The public event interface does not prove item-level fiber origin, mill, labor, chemical, inventory or product-passport data for every runway garment.
beats.credit: Graphic © Rayven-Nikkita Collins; sources in claim ledger
